answer_quality.metric_policy: Answer correctness, evidence faithfulness, unsupported claim rate, citation precision/recall, and abstention correctness are reported separately.

experiment_chapter_draft.title: ATMONTO-constrained advisory KG extraction and GraphRAG evaluation
experiment_chapter_draft.claim_boundary: The experiment is retrospective and source-bounded. It evaluates extraction, CQ queryability, and generated-answer behavior as separate layers; it does not make live operational decision-support claims.

experiments.heading: Experiment A: ATMONTO-constrained KG extraction
experiments.summary: Compare rule-only, schema-slice LLM, validator-repair, and hybrid S4 outputs against reviewed ATCSCC advisory facts.

experiments.heading: Experiment B: CQ queryability / answer-set quality
experiments.summary: Use six CQ query templates to measure whether graph outputs recover source-bounded answer sets with evidence.

experiments.heading: Experiment C: GraphRAG answer generation
experiments.summary: Generate deterministic source-only, vector proxy, graph-only, and hybrid GraphRAG answers over the answer-eval benchmark with a critic gate before S4 evidence enters graph/hybrid answers.
